title: Practice French
subtitle: Strengthen your skills with focused exercises.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: Build a strong foundation with essential French structures.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.description: Build your French vocabulary through focused practice.

adjectives.title: Adjectives
adjectives.description: Practice describing people and things with French adjectives.

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.description: Practice the structures and rules that help you form French sentences.

conjugation.title: Conjugation
conjugation.description: Practice French verbs and the ways they change across common tenses.

definite-articles.title: Definite Articles
definite-articles.subtitle: le, la, les, l’
definite-articles.description: Practice choosing the correct definite article for each noun.

indefinite-articles.title: Indefinite Articles
indefinite-articles.subtitle: un, une, des
indefinite-articles.description: Practice using indefinite articles when talking about people and things.

partitive-articles.title: Partitive Articles
partitive-articles.subtitle: du, de la, de l’, des
partitive-articles.description: Practice using partitive articles to talk about unspecified quantities.

demonstratives.title: Demonstratives
demonstratives.subtitle: ce, cet, cette, ces
demonstratives.description: Practice using demonstratives to identify people and things.

possessives.title: Possessives
possessives.subtitle: mon, ma, mes...
possessives.description: Practice using possessives to show who something belongs to.

subject-pronouns.title: Subject Pronouns
subject-pronouns.subtitle: elle, ils, nous, vous
subject-pronouns.description: Practice choosing the correct subject pronoun in French sentences.

cest-ce-sont-il-y-a.title: C’est / Ce sont, Il y a
cest-ce-sont-il-y-a.subtitle: Common basic sentence structures
cest-ce-sont-il-y-a.description: Practice some of the most common basic structures used in French.

common-adjectives.title: Common Adjectives
common-adjectives.description: Practice common adjectives used to describe people and things.

masculine-feminine.title: Masculine / Feminine
masculine-feminine.description: Practice identifying and using masculine and feminine forms.

singular-plural.title: Singular / Plural
singular-plural.description: Practice identifying and using singular and plural forms.

adjective-agreement.title: Adjective Agreement
adjective-agreement.description: Practice making adjectives agree with the nouns they describe.

negation.title: Negation — ne...pas
negation.description: Practice forming negative sentences using ne...pas.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Practice forming and understanding questions in French.

question-words.title: Question Words
question-words.description: Practice common words used to ask questions in French.

prepositions.title: Prepositions
prepositions.description: Practice common French prepositions and how they are used.

contractions.title: Contractions — au, aux, du, des
contractions.description: Practice common French contractions formed with à and de.

quantities.title: Quantities
quantities.description: Practice words and expressions used to talk about quantities.

etre.title: Être
etre.description: Practice conjugating and using the verb être.

avoir.title: Avoir
avoir.description: Practice conjugating and using the verb avoir.

aller.title: Aller
aller.description: Practice conjugating and using the verb aller.

faire.title: Faire
faire.description: Practice conjugating and using the verb faire.

er-verbs.title: Verbs Ending in -ER
er-verbs.description: Practice the basic conjugation pattern of regular -ER verbs.

irregular-verbs.title: Irregular Verbs
irregular-verbs.description: Practice the conjugation patterns of common irregular French verbs.

common-verbs.title: Common Verbs
common-verbs.description: Practice conjugating and using frequently used French verbs.

present.title: Present
present.description: Practice using the present tense to talk about actions and situations.

near-future.title: Near Future
near-future.description: Practice forming and using the near future with aller.

passe-compose.title: Passé Composé
passe-compose.description: Practice forming and using the passé composé for completed actions.
